attempts.summary: On node1, created datauser and a dedicated 512M XFS filesystem (loop-mounted from /srv/data.img) at /srv/data with the prjquota mount option persisted in /etc/fstab. Configured XFS project quota (project id 100, name datauser) mapping /etc/projid and /etc/projects, and set a 100MB hard/soft block limit via xfs_quota. Verified enforcement (write beyond 100MB fails with ENOSPC) both before and after a full node restart, confirming the quota, mount, and data persist across reboot.
